# Muraduzzaman — Growth Engineer

> Solo operator in Dhaka, Bangladesh, working globally. Combines 7 years of technical SEO with full-stack engineering to ship end-to-end growth systems — from ranking strategy through to the Chrome extensions, Python scrapers, Shopify themes, and WebGL brand sites that execute it.

## What I do

- **Technical SEO, AEO, GEO** — audits, architecture, content clusters, schema, Core Web Vitals
- **Full-stack engineering** — Python (FastAPI, Flask, Playwright), JavaScript/Node, Chrome extensions, Shopify Liquid, Three.js/WebGL
- **AI automation** — GPT-4o pipelines, agent orchestration, n8n workflows, Resend warmup outreach
- **One hire replaces three** — SEO specialist + web developer + automation consultant in a single contract

## Who I work with

- Startups under ~$5M ARR who need all three skill sets but can't afford three specialists
- Growth teams at mid-market companies needing senior execution without handoff delays
- Agencies sub-contracting specialist SEO + engineering for enterprise clients
- Founders rebuilding their growth engine end-to-end

## Shipped products (selected)

- **[BrandiVibe](https://mjrifat.com/work/brandivibe/)** — Three.js brand site + autonomous GPT-4o sales engine on Koyeb. Daily SEO articles, hourly lead radar across 4 startup feeds, deep-research via Resend warmup outreach, self-learning A/B. Zero daily human input.
- **[ProWorkSpace](https://mjrifat.com/work/proworkspace/)** — AI-powered Chrome extension for Upwork freelancers. Live SaaS with Stripe billing, admin panel, paying users.
- **[Forex Lead Finder](https://mjrifat.com/work/forex-lead-finder/)** — Python engine harvesting 5 platforms (Reddit, TradingView, BabyPips, ForexFactory, LinkedIn) with a 15-point classifier + SQLite warehouse + Flask UI + 6-hour scheduled loop.
- **[AYVA](https://mjrifat.com/work/ayva/)** — Shopify Dawn fork, zero third-party apps, Lighthouse 95 mobile, 50 products migrated.
- **[Email Outreach Engine](https://mjrifat.com/work/email-outreach/)** — Playwright email extractor + rate-capped sender with deliverability guardrails.
- **[Google Maps Lead Extractor](https://mjrifat.com/work/maps-extractor/)** — SerpAPI-based business-lead pipeline for any geo + keyword.
